name: Early Tetrahedron Termination
definition: A technique that reduces the amount of processed tetrahedra by leveraging a summed-area table for accumulating and comparing opacity of individual tetrahedra on the rendering phase, after they have been sorted into unobstructed layers.
summary: Early Tetrahedron Termination optimizes volume rendering by using a summed-area table to skip processing tetrahedra once accumulated opacity meets a threshold, reducing computational load.
